title: Descendible
summary: DESCENDIBLE, adjective 1. That may be descended, or passed down; as, the hill is descendible 2. That may descend from an ancestor to an heir; as a descendible estate.

inlines.v: DESCENDIBLE, adjective 1. That may be descended, or passed down; as, the hill is descendible 2. That may descend from an ancestor to an heir; as a descendible estate.
